description: Get one product of the rikma in full merchant detail: its base row (price, quant, pricingMode, status_of_voting, lifecycle, archived, hideFromDiscovery, lowStockAt, unit, minOrder, maxOrder, leadTimeHours, externalKey, pricing fields), its gallery and delivery options, its option axes (product-option), every variant (sku, axisKey, optionValues, price, quant, active, position, externalKey), categories, and computed inventory (effectiveStock, isLowStock, lowVariants). Members only. Use it to verify a product before editing stock, pricing or variants. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#getRikmaProductTool

includeArchived.description: Allow a row that is archived lifecycle=false. Default true for a direct get.

name: getRikmaProductTool
